purpose: Complete standard-rail manifests with the verdict the gateway gives each when it starts.
check: src/standardRail/artifacts.ts verifyStandardRailManifest(manifest, trust), with the clock at clock.now

clock.note: Unix seconds. An envelope is valid while issuedAt <= now < validBefore.

keys.warning: Synthetic keys derived from public labels. They sign nothing real, hold no funds and must never be configured for any network.
keys.derivation: privateKey = keccak256(utf8(label)); address = EIP-55 address of privateKey
keys.signature: EIP-191 personal_sign over the raw 32-byte keccak256 of the canonical JSON of the envelope without its signature; deterministic (RFC 6979)

manifestSigner.label: daski rail-manifest example key: manifestSigner (test only)
manifestSigner.role: Trusted: signs every manifest envelope unless an example says otherwise

untrustedSigner.label: daski rail-manifest example key: untrustedSigner (test only)
untrustedSigner.role: Trusted for no key ID: an envelope it signs must be refused

sharedProviderWallet.label: daski rail-manifest example key: sharedProviderWallet (test only)
sharedProviderWallet.role: The one provider wallet both shared-origin control profiles name as assetResponseKey

ownOriginProviderWallet.label: daski rail-manifest example key: ownOriginProviderWallet (test only)
ownOriginProviderWallet.role: The provider wallet of the provider on its own origin

sharedOrigin.note: Exact texts: the origin without a trailing slash, the audience with one, each provider's six URLs under its own base. They are what the gateway stores from a provider card naming this origin and audience.

verdicts.accepted: The check resolves: a gateway given this manifest starts.
verdicts.refused: The check rejects with exactly gatewayError: a gateway given this manifest does not start. Every refused example is accepted.shared-origin with the one defect its purpose names; every envelope the defect does not concern keeps a valid signature.

examples.purpose: Two providers on one origin with one provider wallet and one audience, each under its own path. One is admitted for servicing with an action catalog; the other carries a control profile only.
The same two control profiles with no servicing admission and no action catalog at all: a profile needs neither.
A provider on its own origin, written with a trailing slash and an audience without one, admitted for servicing, beside two profile-only providers on the shared origin.
A profile origin is a bare origin: the provider's path belongs in its URLs.
examples.gatewayError: Provider control profile origin must be a credential-free HTTPS origin

examples.purpose: Every URL of a profile lies on the profile's origin.
examples.gatewayError: dispatchUrl must be a credential-free query-free URL on the pinned provider origin

examples.purpose: A provider is told apart by its path, never by a query.
examples.gatewayError: quoteUrl must be a credential-free query-free URL on the pinned provider origin

examples.purpose: One agent carries at most one profile per servicing profile epoch.

examples.purpose: The agent id is decimal text without a leading zero.
